notes.title: Blacksmith Bay 2023 Roadmap!
notes.content:
Our 2022 timeline included a flood of new features:

Totally reworked Combat
The Character Creator
A new tutorial at the Blacksmithing Academy
Modular shop upgrades
Improvements to shopkeeping (smarter shoppers, smarter tables, etc)
The Skill System!
The ability to Unlock new parts


All of that is in the game now!

So get hyped for 2023, it's an ambitious schedule, but we're in the home stretch now!
